messages:
Alex: Heads-up: planning to cut release/1.16 tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Need final semver checks, changelog polish, and any emergency backports. If you need a different window, speak now.
Kim: 09:30 UTC works. Quick callout: please label PRs with `release/1.16-ready` so the release script picks them up.
Jonah: Also verify any public API changes include a CHANGELOG entry and a docs note. Minor bumps only when API surface actually changes.
Tara: I have a perf regression fix that should go into 1.16. Do we want a direct cherry-pick or a normal backport PR?
Alex: Tara 7 please open a backport PR targeting release/1.16. Use the title prefix `backport(1.16):` and include the original commit SHA in the body.
Jonah: Use `git cherry-pick -x <sha>` for traceability and add a short test mentioning the scenario.
Kate: I added a changelog line for the KV cache tweak to the draft notes. Someone please sanity-check formatting (markdown list with PR links).
SRE_Jen: If we cut at 09:30, can we run canary 09:40-10:10 UTC? I want to validate the new batching fallback under load.
Alex: Canary window noted. I'll schedule the canary job and hook up the alerts to the `release-monitor` channel.
release-bot: Preflight for release/1.16:
- main CI green 
- No open P1 regressions
- All `release/1.16-ready` PRs have changelog entries
- Release notes draft: /docs/release-notes/1.16.md
- Branch protection and required reviewers set
Alex: One more: after branch creation the `protected` flag goes on, so no direct pushes. Merge approved backports before I push the branch.
Kim: If anyone needs the branch earlier for long-running CI, shout now. Otherwise 09:30 is the plan.
Jonah: I'll scan for any PRs touching the public SDK surface and flag potential minors.
Tara: Backport PR opened: #4238 -> release/1.16. Includes SHA and test steps. Assigning Alex + Kim.
Alex: Thanks. For cherry-pick etiquette: don't include whitespace-only fixes, run `./tools/build_image --mini` and `./tools/run_unit_tests` locally before requesting approvals.
Kate: Noted one more doc nit in the release notes, fixed.
Jonah: Smoke script ready: `./scripts/release_smoke.sh --branch release/1.16 --duration 15m`. Will post trace link when running.
release-bot: Branch creation scheduled at 1769807400.
Alex: Creating branch now. Commands I'm running:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
# push protected branch
git push origin release/1.16
```
Alex: Branch created and pushed: https://git.internal/repo/releases/1.16
SRE_Jen: Canary started and dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/release/1-16-canary
Jonah: First 10m smoke looks clean, no new errors. Will keep monitoring tracing for tail latency.
Kim: Looks good from docs side, I'll finalize the release notes and tag after canary completes.
Alex: Great work team. I'll post a post-cut summary after the canary window closes. Closing this coordination thread. :tada:
